description: Source code for OpenH264 video encoder implementation within Chromium project, including initialization, encoding, and configuration management.

classes.name: OpenH264VideoEncoder
classes.description: Implementation of a video encoder using OpenH264, supporting initialization, encoding, configuration changes, and color space updates.

classes.name: OpenH264VideoEncoder::ISVCEncoderDeleter
classes.description: Custom deleter for managing the lifecycle of ISVCEncoder instances.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the encoder with specified profile, options, and callbacks.

methods.name: DrainOutputs
methods.description: Processes encoded frame info into output buffers and handles conversion if needed.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Encodes a given video frame, handling format conversions and keyframe requests.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes the encoder, finalizing any pending frames.

methods.name: UpdateEncoderColorSpace
methods.description: Reinitializes encoder parameters to match the current color space.
